Subject: Your breach of contract matter - Com. S. No. 1642/2025

Dear Ms. Varghese,

Thank you for meeting us on 18 June 2025 about your dispute with Sai Logistics Ltd. As we understand it, the counterparty terminated the contract without notice.

Our advice is to send a notice of breach giving the cure period required by the contract. Please collect the contract, the termination letter and the board minutes and send copies to this office. We will pursue the full claim of Rs. 9,70,00,000.

Regards,
Adv. Mrinalini Saraf
